## Material Re Allocation of FG   [p.23]
In case the user receive a PO form the buyer then can have a provision on the Material Re Allocation   [p.23]
where we can transfer the GF stock form one OC to the other,   [p.23]
so below is the process to follow .   [p.23]

## Path: - Production > Material Re Allocation > New   [p.23]

## Page   [p.24]
24   [p.24]
of   [p.24]
41   [p.24]

## OC where the   [p.24]
fulfilment type is “Purchase”   [p.24]

type is “Purchase”   [p.24]
